title: Brass bands he heard as a kid; his father in the Elks band
summary: He remembers few brass bands, his father playing alto in the Elks and Moose bands, and his own approach of changing beats behind each soloist.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Getting my first drums, with or without lessons
